state.claim: The reform raised employment across all age groups.

candidates.text: The reform timetable applies across all age groups; employment results follow later.
We explain how employment and age groups were recorded for the reform.
The reform employment dataset covers all age groups.
The employment reform across all age groups received research funding.
For workers aged 25–54, the policy increased the fraction holding a job by four percentage points.
Among people younger than 25 and older than 54, the policy reduced the fraction holding a job by two percentage points.
Employment across all age groups is the focus of the reform proposal.
The reform employment questionnaire listed all age groups.
The reform raised questions about employment across all age groups.
The employment reform across all age groups was debated in parliament.
Employment reform and age groups are the keywords of this report.
